kit_properties: Every number in every draft matches the Fact Sheet or a story's own numbers.
No draft names a person whose story marks them as not to be named.
No sentence uses any of these words: passionate, synergy, journey, best-in-class, thought leader, impactful, rockstar, crushing it.

The goals essay names the short-term goal specifically: A general manager or business unit role at a distribution, logistics or consumer company — a P&L of $100 to $300 million where operations is one of the levers rather than the whole job.
The leadership essay leads with "The contract nobody wanted to sign", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
The setback essay leads with "The go-live I should have delayed", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
